analysis.fit: simultaneous weighted sine-cosine regression in magnitude space
analysis.period_selection: generic Fourier weighted residual minimum within plus-or-minus 0.1 percent of the published period
analysis.phase_unwrapping: nearest branch around the full-sample estimate

claim_boundary: Fourier-coordinate consistency and evidence independence only; not a DERD population result, physical mechanism, shell, prevalence, or mass claim.

classification_policy.external_analysis_consistent_partial_sou: joint p-value at least 0.05 and all marginal absolute z scores below 2, but source independence or source completeness is absent
classification_policy.external_analysis_inconsistent_partial_s: joint or marginal consistency gate fails while source independence or completeness is absent
classification_policy.external_independent_astrophysical_repli: requires external research-group independence, independent observing source, known source-byte identity, source completeness, and both consistency gates

consistency_gate.joint_test: Mahalanobis chi-square using local bootstrap covariance plus published diagonal covariance

external_anchor.citation: Jurkovic et al. 2022, MNRAS 518, 642-663, Appendix A Table A1
external_anchor.formula_convention: cosine series with R_i1=A_i/A_1 and phi_i1=phi_i-i*phi_1
